jd_snapshots.title: Clinical Research Associate I
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: ICON Shanghai CRA I official careers page: coordinates study set-up and monitoring activities; prepares accurate study status reports and maintains study documentation; manages sponsor queries; supports feasibility and study-document preparation; works with investigators and site staff; follows procedures, protocols, and regulatory requirements for patient safety. Requires a medicine/science degree, ICH-GCP knowledge, medical-data review capability, English communication, and approximately 60% travel.

jd_snapshots.title: Clinical Research Associate
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: ICON China Clinical Research Associate | Shanghai official careers page: conduct site qualification, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits; ensure protocol compliance, data integrity, and patient safety; collaborate with investigators and site staff; review data and resolve queries; contribute to study-document preparation and review. Requires a scientific or healthcare degree, at least two years CRA experience, ICH-GCP knowledge, communication skills, and travel.

jd_snapshots.title: CRA I
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: ICON China CRA I | Shanghai official careers page: identify, select, initiate, monitor, and close investigational sites for phase II-IV studies under ICH-GCP; independently set up and monitor studies, complete status reports and maintain documentation; submit protocol and consent documents for ethics review and assist regulatory submissions; manage sponsor queries and support study documentation and feasibility work. Senior cost-efficiency and mentoring language is level-dependent.
signals: status reports, documentation, and sponsor-query follow-up
independent and senior wording retained as JD-dependent

rubric.factuality: Score 1-5 against confirmed persona facts; invented monitoring, tool, outcome, quantity, or responsibility claims are unsupported.

rubric.unsupported_claim_audit: Record critical/noncritical claims separately; any critical factuality or ownership failure fails the run.
